remedies: written grievance to the regulated entity

deadline_rules: wait for rejection or 30 days without a reply before the Ombudsman complaint
file within one year of the reply, or one year and 30 days from the written complaint if there is no reply
documents: written complaint to the regulated entity
reply or proof that 30 days passed without reply
escalation: RBI CMS only after confirming the provider is a regulated entity and Clause 10 maintainability
